other_conditions: Master’s degree in agriculture/allied sciences with OGPA ≥ 6.60 / 65 % or equivalent
Fresh candidates must have obtained the qualifying degree not more than two years before the admission date
In‑service Indian candidates must be employed in an ICAR‑AU institution
Indian fellows must return to India after completing the Ph.D. and serve a three‑year bond if employed in ICAR‑AU system
Indian selected fellows must provide a US$10,000 bank guarantee; foreign fellows will have ₹2,00,000 deducted from fellowship installments
Medical fitness test and insurance to be arranged by the fellow at his/her own cost
All host‑institution fees are to be borne by the fellow
Fellow must not change place of work or research area during the fellowship and must devote full time to the research
Progress report to be submitted every six months
Dissertation/thesis and brief activity report to be submitted within 15 days of program completion
benefits_summary: Monthly stipend (US$2,000 for Indian fellows abroad or INR 40,000 for overseas fellows in India) plus annual contingent‑expense allowance, travel tickets, and other allowances for a three‑year Ph.D. fellowship.
documents_required: Letter of acceptance for Ph.D. admission
Deputation approval letter (for in‑service Indian candidates)
